question: Where can I find a university within 80 kilometers along the west direction from Gabis Arboretum at Purdue Northwest, Valparaiso, IN?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'university' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Gabis Arboretum at Purdue Northwest%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 80000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Gabis Arboretum at Purdue Northwest%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry)) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5;
